item.title: A message from: Mrs. Curtis:
item.description: Are you a Grade 8 Girl who might be considering a career in the skilled trades? If so, the Mobile Training Lab visiting STA at the end of October is for you! Spend the day exploring a variety of tools, equipment, and hands-on learning stations. Top students in the program will be selected to participate in a skilled trades compeition in March! If you're interested, please come see Mrs. Curtis in the Resource Room to sign up!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: A huge thank you to all our staff and students for your participation in this year's food drive as, together, we collected almost 2,500 lbs of food! Congratulations goes out to Mrs. Kwok's class for bringing in the most food in high school, totaling 267 lbs, and to Ms. Brennan's class for bringing in 151 lbs! In grade 7/8, congratulations to Mrs. Mcleod's homeroom class who brought in 400lbs of food, and to Ms. Clouthier's class who brought in 245 lbs! It is amazing to witness the generosity of our school as we make a difference in our community! Thank you to each and every one of you for your participation
